description_en: Creates a server group in a specified region
description_zh: 在指定地域创建服务器组
kebab_example: aliyun nlb create-server-group --server-group-name NLB_ServerGroup --vpc-id vpc-bp15zckdt37pq72zv0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServerGroup

parameters.help_en:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

Instance (default): server type. This type of server group supports adding instances of the Ecs, Eni, and Eci types.

Ip: IP address type. This type of server group supports directly adding backend servers by IP address
parameters.help_zh:
服务器组类型。取值：

Instance（默认值）：服务器类型，该类型服务器组支持添加Ecs、Eni、Eci类型实例。

Ip：IP地址类型，该类型服务器组支持直接添加IP地址类型的后端服务器
parameters.name: server_group_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the server group.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, or Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
服务器组名称。

长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: server_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The protocol version. Valid values:

ipv4 (default): IPv4.

DualStack: dual-stack
parameters.help_zh:
协议版本。取值：

ipv4（默认值）：IPv4类型。

DualStack：双栈类型
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The traffic scheduling policy in dual-stack mode:

NonAffinity (default): non-affinity mode. Traffic is forwarded to healthy backend servers based on the scheduling algorithm, regardless of the IP protocol version of the source.
Affinity: affinity mode. Traffic is forwarded based on the IP protocol version of the request source. IPv4 requests are forwarded only to IPv4 backend servers, and IPv6 requests are forwarded only to IPv6 backend servers.
This parameter takes effect only when AddressIPVersion is set to DualStack
parameters.help_zh:
双栈模式下的流量调度策略：

NonAffinity（默认）：无亲和模式，转发时不区分来源的IP协议版本，按照调度算法向健康的后端转发。
Affinity：亲和模式，转发时根据请求来源的IP协议版本亲和转发，IPv4请求仅转发至IPv4后端，IPv6请求仅转发至IPv6后端。
仅AddressIPVersion为DualStack时，该参数生效
parameters.name: ip_version_affinity_mode

parameters.help_en:
The communication protocol used to forward requests to the backend servers. Valid values:

TCP (default)
UDP
TCP_UDP

If this parameter is set to UDP, the server group can be associated only with UDP listeners.
If this parameter is set to TCP and PreserveClientIpEnabled is set to true, the server group can be associated only with TCP listeners.
If this parameter is set to TCP and PreserveClientIpEnabled is set to false, the server group can be associated with TCPSSL listeners and TCP listeners.
If this parameter is set to TCP_UDP, the server group can be associated with TCP listeners and UDP listeners
parameters.help_zh:
转发到后端服务器使用的通信协议。取值：

TCP（默认值）
UDP
TCP_UDP

当该参数取值为UDP时，该服务器组只支持关联UDP监听。
当该参数取值为TCP且PreserveClientIpEnabled取值为true时，该服务器组只支持关联TCP监听。
当该参数取值为TCP且PreserveClientIpEnabled取值为false时，该服务器组支持关联TCPSSL监听和TCP监听。
当该参数取值为TCP_UDP时，该服务器组支持关联TCP监听和UDP监听
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the server group belongs.

If ServerGroupType is set to Instance, only servers in this VPC can be added to the server group
parameters.help_zh:
服务器组所在VPC的ID。

如果ServerGroupType取值为Instance时，只有该VPC下的服务器可以加入到该服务器组
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable all-port forwarding. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启全端口转发。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: any_port_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable connection draining. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启连接优雅中断。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: connection_drain_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period of connection draining. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 0 to 900
parameters.help_zh:
设置连接优雅中断超时时间。单位：秒。
取值范围：0~900
parameters.name: connection_drain_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

Wrr (default): weighted round-robin. Backend servers with higher weights are polled more frequently.

Wlc: weighted least connections. In addition to the weight of each backend server, the actual load (number of connections) is also considered. When the weights are the same, backend servers with fewer current connections are polled more frequently.

rr: round-robin. Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence.

sch: source IP hashing. Requests from the same source IP address are distributed to the same backend server.

tch: four-element hashing. Consistent hashing based on four elements (source IP address, destination IP address, source port, and destination port). The same stream is distributed to the same backend server.

qch: QUIC ID hashing. Requests with the same QUIC ID are distributed to the same backend server.

QUIC ID hashing is supported only when the backend protocol is UDP
parameters.help_zh:
调度算法。取值：

Wrr（默认值）：加权轮询，权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的概率也越高。

Wlc：加权最小连接数，除了根据每台后端服务器设定的权重值来进行轮询，同时还考虑后端服务器的实际负载（即连接数）。当权重值相同时，当前连接数越小的后端服务器被轮询到的概率也越高。

rr：轮询，按照访问顺序依次将外部请求分发到后端服务器。

sch：源IP哈希：相同的源地址会调度到相同的后端服务器。

tch：四元组哈希，基于四元组（源IP、目的IP、源端口和目的端口）的一致性哈希，相同的流会调度到相同的后端服务器。

qch：QUIC ID哈希，支持将同一个QUIC ID的请求哈希到同一台后端服务器上。

仅后端协议为UDP时，支持选择QUIC ID哈希
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable client IP preservation. Valid values:

true (default): enabled.
false: disabled.



If Protocol is set to TCP and this parameter is set to true, the server group cannot be associated with TCPSSL listeners
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启客户端地址保持功能。取值：

true（默认值）：开启。
false：关闭。



当Protocol取值为TCP且该参数取值为true时，该服务器组不支持关联TCPSSL监听
parameters.name: preserve_client_ip_enabled

fields.help_en:
The port of the backend server used for health checks.

Valid values: 0 to 65535.

Default value: 0, which indicates that the port of the backend server is used for health checks
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的后端服务器的端口。

取值范围： 0~65535。

默认值：0，表示使用后端服务器的端口进行健康检查
fields.name: health_check_connect_port

fields.help_en:
The maximum timeout period for a health check response. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 300.
Default value: 5
fields.help_zh:
健康检查响应的最大超时时间。单位：秒。
取值范围：1~300。
默认值：5
fields.name: health_check_connect_timeout

fields.help_en:
The domain name used for health checks. Valid values:

$SERVER_IP: the private IP address of the backend server.

domain: a specific domain name. The domain name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and periods (.).

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
用于健康检查的域名。取值：

$SERVER_IP：使用后端服务器内网IP。

domain：指定特定域名。长度限制1~80个字符，只能使用大小写字母、数字、短划线（-）、半角句号（.）。

仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_domain

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values:

true (default): enabled.

false: disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查，取值：

true（默认值）：开启。

false：关闭
fields.name: health_check_enabled

fields.help_en: The query string in the request for UDP listener health checks. The string can contain only letters and digits, with a maximum length of 512 characters
fields.help_zh: UDP 监听健康检查的请求字符串，只允许包含字母、数字，最大长度限制为 512 个字符
fields.name: health_check_exp

fields.help_en:
The HTTP status codes returned for a healthy backend server. Separate multiple status codes with commas (,).
Valid values: http_2xx (default), http_3xx, http_4xx, and http_5xx.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
健康状态返回码，多个状态码用半角逗号（,）分隔。
取值：http_2xx（默认值）、http_3xx、http_4xx和http_5xx。
仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_http_code

fields.help_en:
The HTTP version for health checks. Valid values: HTTP1.0 (default) and HTTP1.1.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
健康检查HTTP协议版本，取值：HTTP1.0（默认值）或HTTP1.1。

仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_http_version

fields.help_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks. Unit: seconds. Default value: 5.

If HealthCheckType is set to TCP or HTTP, valid values are 1 to 50.
If HealthCheckType is set to UDP, valid values are 1 to 300. Set the interval to a value greater than or equal to the response timeout period to prevent UDP probe responses from being incorrectly identified as non-responses due to timeout
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。单位：秒。默认值：5

HealthCheckType为TCP或者HTTP时，取值范围为：1~50。
HealthCheckType为UDP时，取值范围为：1~300，您需要设置间隔时间>=响应超时时间，以确保UDP探测回包不会因为超时而被误判为未响应
fields.name: health_check_interval

fields.help_en: The query string in the request for UDP listener health checks. The string can contain only letters and digits, with a maximum length of 512 characters
fields.help_zh: UDP 监听健康检查的请求字符串，只允许包含字母、数字，最大长度限制为 512 个字符
fields.name: health_check_req

fields.help_en:
The protocol used for health checks. Valid values:

TCP
HTTP
UDP
fields.help_zh:
健康检查协议。取值：

TCP
HTTP
UDP
fields.name: health_check_type

fields.help_en:
The Health Check Path.

The path must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, and the following characters: `-/.%?#&`. It must start with a forward slash (/).
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
健康检查路径。

长度为1~80个字符，只能使用大小写英文字母、数字、字符`-/.%?#&`。 必须以正斜线（/）开头。
仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_url

fields.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks that must occur before a backend server is declared healthy (changes status from fail to success).

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 2
fields.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由失败判定为成功。

取值范围：2~10。

默认值：2
fields.name: healthy_threshold

fields.help_en:
The health check method. Valid values: GET (default) and HEAD.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
健康检查方法，取值：GET（默认值）或HEAD。
仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: http_check_method

fields.help_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks that must occur before a backend server is declared unhealthy (changes status from success to fail).

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 2
fields.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由成功判定为失败。

取值范围：2~10。

默认值：2
fields.name: unhealthy_threshold

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the server group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 服务器组所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without creating the server group. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): sends the request. After the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建服务器组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. Valid characters include letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), forward slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@).

You can add up to 20 tags in each call
fields.help_zh:
标签键。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。支持字符包括字母、数字、下划线 (_)、点 (.)、冒号 (:)、斜线 (/)、等号 (=)、加号 (+)、减号 (-)、@符号 (@) 。

一次调用最多支持添加20个标签
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. Valid characters include letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), forward slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@).

You can add up to 20 tags in each call
fields.help_zh:
标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。支持字符包括字母、数字、下划线 (_)、点 (.)、冒号 (:)、斜线 (/)、等号 (=)、加号 (+)、减号 (-)、@符号 (@) 。

一次调用最多支持添加20个标签
fields.name: value
